# The Milano Seal™ — Paid & Released Email Template

**Use:** Send to client after courier release / digital document delivery  
**Sender:** Nicholas Milano (direct, not automated)  
**Timing:** Within 2 hours of courier release or digital delivery upload

---

## Template

**Subject:** Completion Confirmation — Milano Seal Execution Finalized

---

Dear <<CLIENT_NAME>>,

I hope you are doing well.

I’m pleased to confirm that your matter has been fully completed.

All documents have been properly executed, notarized in accordance with Florida law, and prepared for international use. Where applicable, apostille processing has been finalized and all coordination responsibilities have been fulfilled.

Attached for your records is your Paid & Released Certificate, confirming that all services have been completed in full and that no outstanding balance remains.

If you or your colleagues require assistance with future U.S. document execution, notarization, or apostille coordination, I would be honored to support your office.

Wishing you continued success, and thank you again for the trust.

Warm regards,

Nicholas Milano  
The Milano Seal™

---

## Usage Notes

- Replace `<<CLIENT_NAME>>` before sending
- Attach only the approved, locked `PaidReleased` PDF
- Do NOT attach a Pro Forma, draft, internal note, payment log, or raw courier record
- Do NOT include Wise reference, payment details, or pricing in this email
- Do NOT include discount information or pricing overrides
- Log the delivery immediately after sending
